statement: Add the "Weld" modifier to an object stack, set its parameters and get the same resulting geometry or data as Blender 5.3; reordering, disabling or removing it re-evaluates the result non-destructively.
notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork2_blender_mesh_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: two quads with a 0.0004 seam gap: distance 0.0001 merges nothing (8 vertices), distance 0.001 merges the 2 seam pairs (V 6, E 7, F 2); a cluster of 3 within the distance collapses to 1; documentation: Blender Manual, page 'weld' (docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest) (definition paraphrased: finds groups of vertices closer than the Distance and merges them); the page text could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased and the sentence is not quoted; Tested: Mode All with a distance. Untested: Mode Connected, vertex-group restriction, loose-edge option. Untested: the non-destructive modifier stack (reorder, disable, remove re-evaluates the result), parameters not named here, and comparison against Blender's own output data. | Name is the label as printed in Appendix B; ref is derived from it.
